# MANAGED_RESOURCE_PROVIDER

A provider is healthy and the resource kinds it defines can be applied.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `resourceProvider`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.resourceProvider`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
